//: Separate from jest-e2e.json because the two need opposite module loaders. Prisma 7's client uses a dynamic import() that Jest only permits under NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules (see the test:integration script). That same flag makes Jest take the VM-ESM path, which needs Node 24.9+ to load better-auth's ESM synchronously and so breaks every AppModule test. Specs here therefore hit the real database but must never import AppModule, auth.guard, or anything else that reaches better-auth.
